payload.title: A GraphQL operation over its @RateLimit budget (login, refresh, MFA, password reset) throws an HttpException that reaches the client as INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, and the production error formatters drop the wait the guard computed
evidence: apps/gateway-api/src/app.module.ts:323 (production formatError keeps only message and code)
payload.rule_violated: A throttled request is answered TOO_MANY_REQUESTS with the wait, never as a server fault
payload.notes: Fixed in the guard, the subgraph preset and the gateway formatter (formatGatewayError).
narrative: Production 2026-10-26: refresh bucket 11/10..17/10 on the audit crawl surfaced to the browser as INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR.
